feat: Major codebase organization and GSAP animation implementation

## Core Changes

## New Features & Components
- Add TestGSAP component and animation hooks (useSimpleAnimation, useUltraterrestrialAnimation)
- Create home-animated layout with GSAP integration

## Technical Improvements
- Update package dependencies in app/package.json
- Enhance RAG LLM handler functionality
- Add disclosure-rag API server improvements
- Create scraping utilities for UFO case book data

## Documentation
- Add comprehensive agent implementation plans for Claudia
- Create knowledge base agent documentation
- Add GSAP animation guide for future development
- Document research methodology and entity relationships

This commit represents a significant milestone in organizing the codebase, 
implementing core animation features, and establishing the foundation 
for advanced AI agent integration.
